description: Add or update a portfolio project (upsert). Omit id to create (title and shortDescription are required); pass an id (from get_profile) to update, changing only the fields you send. Projects are the #1 differentiator for junior/mid developers. Help the user recognize work they might not think of: side projects, open-source contributions, hackathon entries, internal tools, time-saving scripts, blogs, personal apps. Saving without an id always creates a new entry. Saved entries appear on the user's public profile, so they should describe real work.

id.description: Present: update this project (only the fields you pass change). Omit: create a new one (title and shortDescription are required to create).

isCurrent.description: Whether this is an ongoing project (default false on create)

isOpenSource.description: Whether this is open source (default false on create)

isRemote.description: Whether this was remote work (default false on create)

shortDescription.description: A one-line summary of the project

name: save_project
title: Save Project
